events.artist: Ursula Oppens with The Hemphill Stringtet
events.subtitle: Christian Wolff world premiere / Julius Hemphill revisited
events.category: Living masters / avant-jazz and contemporary-classical collaboration
events.factual_description: Roulette bills a world premiere piano quintet by Christian Wolff alongside Julius Hemphill's One Atmosphere and Parchment, both written for Ursula Oppens, plus new arrangements including Dogon A.D. The program joins Oppens with the Hemphill Stringtet on February 28, 2027 at 8:00 p.m.

en.why_it_matters: Christian Wolff's new piano quintet meets Julius Hemphill's music in the hands of Ursula Oppens, the musician for whom two of these Hemphill works were written. The Stringtet makes this a live conversation between avant-jazz and new-music lineages, not a commemorative recital.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this Roulette performance if planning New York in late February; the premiere and firsthand Hemphill connection make it an A+ night, not a mandate to travel solely for it.

es.why_it_matters: Ursula Oppens estrena un quinteto para piano de Christian Wolff y vuelve a las piezas que Julius Hemphill escribió para ella, ahora junto al Hemphill Stringtet. Es un diálogo vivo entre el jazz de vanguardia y la música contemporánea, no un homenaje de rutina.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a esta función en Roulette si hay viaje a Nueva York a finales de febrero: el estreno y el vínculo directo con Hemphill ameritan A+, sin venderlo como motivo para viajar exclusivamente.

events.subtitle: Mixology Festival: homemade sound machines and custom instruments
lineup: Ashcan Orchestra — P. Spadine and Sam Sowydra (additional performers unannounced)
Ivana Dama — custom instruments, analog electronics and sensors
events.factual_description: At Roulette's Mixology Festival on February 11, 2027, Ashcan Orchestra presents works for handmade instruments built largely from salvaged materials, including a new multimedia setting of variations on a cloud i saw 1 time. Ivana Dama opens with In The Shape of (Almost) Anything using custom instruments, analog synthesizers and capacitive sensors developed in connection with MIT's Center for Bits and Atoms.

en.why_it_matters: Two genuine instrument-building practices share a bill: Ashcan turns salvaged materials and DIY circuits into a playful acoustic machine, while Ivana Dama uses gesture-sensitive devices to make air, movement and vibration audible. This Mixology pairing is an encounter with how music gets invented, not a conventional electronics set.
en.trip_verdict: Prioritize this Brooklyn show on a February New York visit if experimental performance and sound technology are on the agenda; compelling A+, without evidence that it requires a dedicated trip.

es.why_it_matters: Dos maneras de inventar instrumentos en una misma noche: Ashcan convierte materiales recuperados y circuitos caseros en una máquina sonora; Ivana Dama usa sensores para volver audible el aire, el movimiento y la vibración. El cruce del festival Mixology merece atención por su propuesta concreta, no por la etiqueta de música electrónica.
es.trip_verdict: Si febrero incluye Nueva York, haría espacio para esta noche en Brooklyn, sobre todo si interesan la experimentación y las tecnologías del sonido. Es A+ por el montaje anunciado, no un viaje obligatorio.

events.subtitle: it's easier to imagine the end of the world… — album-release concert
lineup: Anna Webber — tenor/soprano saxophones and flute
events.factual_description: Roulette presents Anna Webber's nine-piece ensemble on March 21, 2027 at 8:00 p.m. for a belated live celebration of her album it's easier to imagine the end of the world… (released October 2026 on Intakt Records). The announced lineup includes Korean gayageum player DoYeon Kim, Mary Halvorson, Ingrid Laubrock and Ches Smith.

en.why_it_matters: An unusually imaginative nine-piece cast puts DoYeon Kim's 25-string gayageum inside Anna Webber's precision-built avant-jazz, alongside Mary Halvorson, Ingrid Laubrock and Ches Smith. The exact ensemble—not merely the record-release label—makes this an A+ listening opportunity.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for the nonet if a March New York trip is feasible: a sharply curated A+ lineup, but no verified one-off premiere requiring a special journey.

es.why_it_matters: El noneto de Anna Webber reúne al gayageum coreano de 25 cuerdas de DoYeon Kim con Mary Halvorson, Ingrid Laubrock y Ches Smith. La alineación abre un espacio muy particular entre la improvisación y la composición; aquí importa esa combinación de músicos, no la etiqueta de presentación de disco.
es.trip_verdict: Si hay viaje a Nueva York en marzo, apartaría la noche para este noneto: una alineación A+ que vale priorizar, sin atribuirle el carácter irrepetible de un estreno.
